purpose: Add uninspected qualification data before the next cause-led packing proposal; previous ten roots now serve as regression cases
selectionRule: First four positive signed-long seeds not in the existing ten-root PCB packing cohort; no selection or substitution based on outcome
baseline: Exact accepted13/density12 ROLE source, native actual generation and physical admission. No production source change. Require every predeclared baseline route accepted; retain/report any failure without swapping seeds or blessing missing metrics.
collection: Record actual geometry/area/protected-void/copper/vias, component/pad census, source-plan graph hash, seeds, chosen attempt, rank order, current owner counters and elapsed phase time. placementEvaluations is the maintained sum of accepted raw-plan evaluations and excludes discarded partial work; do not call it total attempted work.
blinding: Keep baseline measurement values uninspected by root and workers until the next proposal's source is frozen and that proposal has passed the existing ten regression roots. Collection output is captured; inspect only schema/status/provenance and checksums beforehand. This is a workflow boundary, not a cryptographic access guarantee.
nextProposal: Investigate existing demand-derived soft isolation-package boundary targeting, without new weights or hard allowed rectangles. Declare its source scope before edits. Do not design or tune it from these four baseline values.
qualification: After proposal freeze and existing-ten acceptance, freshly generate all four proposed cases. All must physically admit, retain source graph/identities and fixed bounds, and must not regress area/void/copper/vias against frozen accepted13. At least one strict area/void improvement is required somewhere in the full fourteen; no case dropping or seed replacement. Full identity/native/GWT/player gates remain additional requirements.
limits: Four additional finite native PCB cases, not allseed, normal advanced/HARD, solver/customer proof, modesthost, optimum or manufacturing release
publication: Normal established branch only; no main/email. Preserve original five untracked entries and unrelated work.
